items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Baby Lovett, do you remember? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's him. Yeah, he was very, to me.

ctx.x: We were playing like Kansas City. I thought we had that contest in Kansas City with Fender Harris' orchestra. And this, a baby, a drummer from here. He's a bright fellow. He looked like white.
One fellow I knew, I didn't think he was quite that light, but Baby Lovett, do you remember? Baby Lovett.
That's him. Yeah, he was very, to me.
